title: Share an issued document
description: Publishes the reference of an issued document (identifier, title, type, number, version, Storage path and SHA-256 of the PDF) as a record of the native application data broker, then grants or removes read access for one member. The PDF stays in Storage. A record is private to its owner until shared; sharing never gives access to the service. expected_revision is 0 for the first publication, else the revision returned by the previous call.

doc_id.description: Document identifier: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens

confirmation_manuelle.description: Manual confirmation: oui (or true) to proceed

expected_revision.description: 0 (or empty) to create the reference, else the current revision of the shared record

share_subject_user_id.description: Member to grant or remove; empty to only publish the reference

fields.name: expected_revision
fields.title: Révision attendue (0 pour une première publication)
